summary: This watch uses 4 lamps on top for the hour, which must stay inside 0 to 11, and 6 lamps below for the minute, which must stay inside 0 to 59. Each lamp is a binary bit with the low bit at the right. Read a non-negative integer n that counts how many lamps are on. Write every time the lamps might display. Hours omit a leading zero, so 1:00 is fine and 01:00 is not. Minutes always have two digits, so 10:02 is fine and 10:2 is not. The times may be listed in any order.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
